Here the limits of the numerator and denominator are ${lim}_{x\to {\frac{\pi }{2}}^{-}}\operatorname{tan}⁡x=\infty $ and ${lim}_{x\to {\frac{\pi }{2}}^{-}}{e}^{\operatorname{tan}⁡x}=\infty ,$ respectively, so we have the case $\frac{\infty }{\infty }.$

Applying L'Hopital's rule, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to {\frac{\pi }{2}}^{-}}\frac{\operatorname{tan}⁡x}{{e}^{\operatorname{tan}⁡x}} & ={lim}_{x\to {\frac{\pi }{2}}^{-}}\frac{[\operatorname{tan}⁡x]^{′}}{{[{e}^{\operatorname{tan}⁡x}]}^{′}} \\  & ={lim}_{x\to {\frac{\pi }{2}}^{-}}\frac{{sec}^{2}⁡x}{{sec}^{2}⁡x\cdot {e}^{\operatorname{tan}⁡x}} \\  & ={lim}_{x\to {\frac{\pi }{2}}^{-}}\frac{\cancel{{sec}^{2}⁡x}}{\cancel{{sec}^{2}⁡x}\cdot {e}^{\operatorname{tan}⁡x}} \\  & ={lim}_{x\to {\frac{\pi }{2}}^{-}}\frac{1}{{e}^{\operatorname{tan}⁡x}} \\  & =0.\end{aligned}
$$
